capabilities: Send a pasted video link to the Clipverb app
Send the link under the cursor or a selected link
Pair the plugin with the app using a pairing code
Explain why the app could not take a link
disambiguation: Not a clipper itself; it only passes a video link to the separate Clipverb desktop app, which writes the note.
extras: The plugin is free but needs the paid Clipverb desktop app (30-day trial) running on the same computer; desktop only; it connects only to 127.0.0.1 on ports 47800-47809 and writes no files itself; interface available in English, Arabic, Spanish and French.
problem: Obsidian cannot pull a video's captions or a summary of it into a note, so that material has to be copied in by hand.

relations.evidence: Send a video link from Obsidian to the Clipverb desktop app.

summary: Sends a video link to the Clipverb desktop app, which files the video's captions or an AI-made summary as a Markdown note in the vault.
